sudo sh -c 'umask 022 && install -D -m 0750 -g 1000 /usr/bin/bwrap /usr/local/lib/smolcorp/bwrap && if [ -e /etc/apparmor.d/abi/4.0 ] && [ -d /sys/kernel/security/apparmor ]; then printf "%s\n" "# Smolcorp: lets its own copy of bubblewrap make the user namespaces that sandboxed hires need. Every program" "# that copy starts runs under smolcorp-bwrap-child too, which denies it every capability and any user namespace." "# Put here by the Smolcorp installer, or by the one command Smolcorp Setup shows." "abi <abi/4.0>," "include <tunables/global>" "" "profile smolcorp-bwrap /usr/local/lib/smolcorp/bwrap flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {" "  capability," "  userns," "  mount," "  umount," "  pivot_root," "  network," "  unix," "  signal," "  ptrace," "  mqueue," "  io_uring," "  dbus," "  /{**,} rwlkm," "  /** pix -> &smolcorp-bwrap//&smolcorp-bwrap-child," "}" "" "profile smolcorp-bwrap-child flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {" "  audit deny capability," "  audit deny userns," "  network," "  unix," "  signal," "  ptrace," "  mqueue," "  io_uring," "  dbus," "  /{**,} rwlkmix," "}" > /etc/apparmor.d/smolcorp-bwrap && apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/smolcorp-bwrap; fi'
